blocks.zh: 第三節：藥品品質系統在無菌製造中的特定要求
blocks.en: Section 3: Specific Requirements for the Pharmaceutical Quality System in Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解藥品品質系統（PQS, Pharmaceutical Quality System）在無菌製造中的額外特定要求，超越 GMP Part I Chapter 1 的基礎要求
blocks.en: Understand the additional requirements that apply to the Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in sterile manufacturing, over and above the baseline requirements of GMP Part I Chapter 1

blocks.zh: 掌握 PQS 的七大無菌製造特定要求（3.1 i–vii），以及每項要求對 CDMO 日常管理的含義
blocks.en: Master the seven sterile-manufacturing-specific PQS requirements (3.1 i–vii) and what each means for day-to-day CDMO management

blocks.zh: 了解高階管理層（Senior Management）在無菌製造 PQS 中被明確賦予的監督職責
blocks.en: Understand the oversight responsibilities that Senior Management is explicitly given in the sterile manufacturing PQS

blocks.zh: 認識非符合事項調查（non-conformity investigation）的範圍界定要求，包括批次放行前的完整調查義務
blocks.en: Recognize the scoping requirements for non-conformity investigations, including the obligation to complete a full investigation before batch release

blocks.zh: 3.1 — PQS Specific Requirements for Sterile Manufacturing / 無菌製造的 PQS 特定要求
blocks.en: 3.1 — PQS Specific Requirements for Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: PQS 在無菌製造中的角色，就像一家航空公司的「安全管理系統（Safety Management System, SMS）」：
blocks.en: The role of the PQS in sterile manufacturing is like an airline's Safety Management System (SMS):

blocks.zh: 通用的 PQS（Chapter 1）= 所有航空公司都必須遵守的基本飛航安全規定
blocks.en: General PQS (Chapter 1) = the basic flight safety rules every airline must follow

blocks.zh: 無菌製造特定 PQS（Section 3）= 長途越洋航班或執行特殊任務（如醫療運送）的航班還需要額外的安全協議
blocks.en: Sterile-manufacturing-specific PQS (Section 3) = the extra safety protocols required for long-haul ocean crossings or special missions (such as medical transport)

blocks.zh: 關鍵類比點：
blocks.en: Key analogy points:

blocks.zh: 要求 ii（知識與技術）= 駕駛長途機型需要額外的型別評定，不是考過基本飛行執照就夠
blocks.en: Requirement ii (knowledge and expertise) = flying a long-haul aircraft requires an additional type rating; a basic pilot license is not enough

blocks.zh: 要求 v（高階管理層）= 航空公司 CEO 不能只關心財務報表，必須定期接收安全委員會報告
blocks.en: Requirement v (Senior Management) = the airline CEO cannot focus only on financial statements and must receive regular reports from the safety committee

blocks.zh: 要求 vii（放行人員）= 航班出發前，機長的「放行簽字」不只是表格勾選，而是基於充分技術判斷的專業決定
blocks.en: Requirement vii (release personnel) = the captain's sign-off before departure is not just a ticked box but a professional decision based on sound technical judgment

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 要求 v（高階管理層監督）的特別意義：
blocks.en: Why requirement v (Senior Management oversight) matters:

blocks.zh: Annex 1 (2022) 明確將「高階管理層（Senior Management）」的監督職責寫入法規。這不是形式性要求——稽查員有時會詢問管理審查的內容、頻率以及管理層的參與程度。如果管理審查記錄顯示高層只是形式性出席、沒有實質討論風險管理結果，這可能被認定為 PQS 缺陷。
blocks.en: Annex 1 (2022) explicitly writes the oversight responsibilities of Senior Management into the regulation. This is not a formality: inspectors sometimes ask about the content and frequency of management review and the level of management involvement. If management review records show that senior leaders merely attended as a formality, without substantive discussion of risk management outcomes, this may be cited as a PQS deficiency.

blocks.zh: 要求 iv（殘留風險接受論據）： 法規允許接受一定的「殘留風險（residual risk）」，但必須有書面論據說明為什麼認為這個殘留風險是可接受的。「我們一直這樣做」或「以前從未出過問題」不是有效的論據。論據必須基於科學評估和歷史數據。
blocks.en: Requirement iv (rationale for accepting residual risk): The regulation allows a certain level of "residual risk" to be accepted, but there must be a documented rationale explaining why that residual risk is considered acceptable. "We have always done it this way" or "we have never had a problem before" is not a valid rationale. The rationale must be based on scientific evaluation and historical data.

blocks.zh: 要求 vi（後端流程）是容易被忽視的盲點： 很多廠商把注意力集中在無菌充填製程，但 Annex 1 明確要求包裝、儲存和運輸也不得損害無菌性。容器密閉完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）測試和冷鏈運輸管控都屬於這個範疇。
blocks.en: Requirement vi (downstream processes) is an easily overlooked blind spot: Many manufacturers focus on the aseptic filling process, but Annex 1 explicitly requires that packaging, storage and transport must not compromise sterility either. Container Closure Integrity (CCI) testing and cold-chain transport controls both fall within this scope.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在準備 EU GMP 初次稽查。稽查員特別關注 Section 3 的符合程度。以下是最可能被審查的文件清單：
blocks.en: A CDMO is preparing for an initial EU GMP inspection. The inspector is paying particular attention to compliance with Section 3. The following is the list of documents most likely to be reviewed:

blocks.zh: 要求 i： 品質風險管理程序（QRM SOP）及其在無菌製程中的應用記錄（FMEA 或 Risk Assessment 報告）
blocks.en: Requirement i: The quality risk management procedure (QRM SOP) and records of its application to sterile processes (FMEA or risk assessment reports)

blocks.zh: 要求 ii： 關鍵人員資歷清單（含無菌製造相關培訓記錄）；知識管理計畫
blocks.en: Requirement ii: List of key personnel qualifications (including sterile-manufacturing-related training records); knowledge management plan

blocks.zh: 要求 iii： 近 2 年的偏差調查報告，特別關注根本原因分析的深度與 CAPA 的有效性驗證
blocks.en: Requirement iii: Deviation investigation reports from the past 2 years, with particular attention to the depth of root cause analysis and the verification of CAPA effectiveness

blocks.zh: 要求 iv： CCS 文件（含風險評估矩陣和殘留風險接受論據）
blocks.en: Requirement iv: CCS documentation (including the risk assessment matrix and the rationale for accepting residual risk)

blocks.zh: 要求 v： 管理審查會議記錄（含風險管理成果討論、高層出席記錄）
blocks.en: Requirement v: Management review meeting minutes (including discussion of risk management outcomes and records of senior management attendance)

blocks.zh: 要求 vi： 容器密閉完整性（CCI）測試程序與結果；運輸驗證報告
blocks.en: Requirement vi: Container closure integrity (CCI) test procedures and results; transport validation reports

blocks.zh: 要求 vii： QP（Qualified Person）或授權放行人員的資歷文件；放行決策 SOP
blocks.en: Requirement vii: Qualification documents for the QP (Qualified Person) or authorized release personnel; release decision SOP

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 要求 vii 說放行人員必須有「adequate knowledge and experience」。若一位 QP 來自非無菌製造背景（例如口服固體劑），他/她需要具備哪些額外資格才能放行無菌批次？
blocks.en: Requirement vii states that release personnel must have "adequate knowledge and experience". If a QP comes from a non-sterile manufacturing background (for example, oral solid dosage), what additional qualifications would they need before releasing sterile batches?

blocks.zh: 要求 iv 提到「殘留風險接受的論據（rationale for acceptance of residual risk）」。請舉一個無菌充填製程中可能存在殘留風險的例子，並說明如何建立接受論據。
blocks.en: Requirement iv refers to a "rationale for acceptance of residual risk". Give an example of a residual risk that may exist in an aseptic filling process and explain how you would build the acceptance rationale.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: PQS 的「加法邏輯」：
blocks.en: The "additive logic" of the PQS:

blocks.zh: Section 3 的結構是在 GMP Part I Chapter 1（基本 PQS 要求）的基礎上，為無菌製造「加上」特定要求。這意味著：
blocks.en: Section 3 is structured to "add" sterile-manufacturing-specific requirements on top of GMP Part I Chapter 1 (the basic PQS requirements). This means:

blocks.zh: 無菌製造廠必須同時符合 Chapter 1 的通用 PQS 要求 AND Section 3 的特定要求
blocks.en: A sterile manufacturing site must comply with both the general PQS requirements of Chapter 1 AND the specific requirements of Section 3

blocks.zh: 非無菌製造廠只需符合 Chapter 1 即可
blocks.en: A non-sterile manufacturing site only needs to comply with Chapter 1

blocks.zh: 這種「疊加式」要求反映了無菌製造的複雜性和患者安全的更高風險
blocks.en: This "layered" approach reflects the complexity of sterile manufacturing and the higher risk to patients

blocks.zh: 七大特定要求概覽（3.1 i–vii）：
blocks.en: Overview of the seven specific requirements (3.1 i–vii):

blocks.zh: 3.2 — Non-Conformities and Batch Release Investigation / 非符合事項調查與批次放行
blocks.en: 3.2 — Non-Conformities and Batch Release Investigation

blocks.zh: 非符合事項（Non-Conformity）的三種具體類型：
blocks.en: Three specific types of non-conformity:

blocks.zh: 無菌測試不合格（Sterility Test Failure）： 最嚴重的結果，通常會觸發重大調查和批次退回/銷毀，除非能確認系統性無菌測試實驗室錯誤（laboratory error）
blocks.en: Sterility test failure: The most serious outcome. It usually triggers a major investigation and batch rejection/destruction, unless a systematic sterility testing laboratory error can be confirmed

blocks.zh: 環境監測超標（EM Excursion）： 微粒計數或微生物監測超出行動限值（action limit）。注意：行動限值不是規格（specification），超標不一定意味著批次自動不合格，但必須調查
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) excursion: Particle counts or microbial monitoring results exceeding the action limit. Note: an action limit is not a specification, so an excursion does not necessarily mean the batch automatically fails, but it must be investigated

blocks.zh: 程序偏差（Deviation from Procedures）： 操作員未按照 SOP 執行，如更衣步驟遺漏、製程參數超出範圍
blocks.en: Deviation from procedures: Operators not following the SOP, such as omitted gowning steps or process parameters out of range

blocks.zh: 調查的四個核心要素：
blocks.en: Four core elements of the investigation:

blocks.zh: 對製程和產品品質的潛在影響評估
blocks.en: Assessment of the potential impact on the process and product quality

blocks.zh: 其他製程或批次是否受到波及（批次擴展調查，batch extension assessment）
blocks.en: Whether other processes or batches are affected (batch extension assessment)

blocks.zh: 明確說明哪些批次納入/排除調查範圍及其理由
blocks.en: A clear statement of which batches are included in or excluded from the scope of the investigation, with the reasons

blocks.zh: 完成調查後才能放行批次
blocks.en: Batches can only be released after the investigation is complete

blocks.zh: 批次放行前的調查要求，就像航空事故調查局（NTSB）的調查原則：
blocks.en: The requirement to investigate before batch release is like the investigation principles of an air accident investigation body (such as the NTSB):

blocks.zh: 一架飛機發生小事故後，不能只修復表面損傷、確認可以起飛就算完成。必須調查：(1) 根本原因；(2) 是否影響其他同型飛機；(3) 明確說明哪些飛機受到影響、哪些不受影響及其論據。調查完成之前，所有受影響的飛機暫停飛行。
blocks.en: After a minor incident, an aircraft cannot be considered cleared simply because the visible damage has been repaired and it is able to fly. The investigation must establish: (1) the root cause; (2) whether other aircraft of the same type are affected; (3) a clear statement of which aircraft are affected and which are not, with the supporting rationale. Until the investigation is complete, all affected aircraft are grounded.

blocks.zh: 無菌批次的偏差調查邏輯相同——調查完成之前，批次不得放行；調查結論必須清楚界定哪些批次在調查範圍內，並有書面論據。
blocks.en: The same logic applies to deviation investigations for sterile batches: a batch must not be released until the investigation is complete, and the investigation conclusion must clearly define which batches are within the scope of the investigation, with a documented rationale.

blocks.zh: 「明確論據記錄批次排除原因」是高頻缺失點：
blocks.en: "Clearly documenting the rationale for excluding batches" is a frequent finding:

blocks.zh: 實務中常見的問題是：當一個偏差發生時，廠方調查後認為「只影響 Batch A，Batch B 和 C 不受影響」，但調查報告中沒有清楚說明為什麼 B 和 C 被排除在外。Annex 1 明確要求這個排除理由必須被「清楚說明且記錄」。
blocks.en: A common problem in practice: when a deviation occurs, the site concludes after investigation that "only Batch A is affected, and Batches B and C are not", but the investigation report does not clearly explain why B and C were excluded. Annex 1 explicitly requires that the reasons for exclusion be "clearly explained and documented".

blocks.zh: 環境監測超標的典型處理流程：
blocks.en: Typical handling flow for an environmental monitoring excursion:

blocks.zh: 即時通知：超標結果當班通知 QA 和生產管理
blocks.en: Immediate notification: notify QA and production management during the same shift as the excursion

blocks.zh: 強化取樣：在超標點周圍進行加強監測
blocks.en: Enhanced sampling: perform intensified monitoring around the excursion location

blocks.zh: 偏差調查：開立偏差報告，調查根本原因（汙染源識別）
blocks.en: Deviation investigation: open a deviation report and investigate the root cause (identify the contamination source)

blocks.zh: 批次影響評估：評估超標期間充填的批次是否受影響
blocks.en: Batch impact assessment: assess whether batches filled during the excursion period are affected

blocks.zh: CAPA：制定矯正行動（如加強消毒頻率、調查人員行為）
blocks.en: CAPA: define corrective actions (such as increased disinfection frequency or review of personnel behavior)

blocks.zh: 批次放行決策：基於完整調查結論，由具備資格的放行人員做出決策
blocks.en: Batch release decision: made by qualified release personnel based on the complete investigation conclusions

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的特別挑戰： 若一個偏差同時影響多個客戶的批次，每個客戶的品質協議（Quality Agreement）可能對通知義務和調查深度有不同要求，需謹慎管理。
blocks.en: Special challenge for CDMOs: If a deviation affects batches for several clients at the same time, each client's Quality Agreement may set different requirements for notification obligations and depth of investigation, which must be managed carefully.

blocks.zh: 批次放行決策框架
blocks.en: Batch Release Decision Framework

blocks.zh:
批次放行前非符合事項處理流程：
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
發現非符合事項（EM超標 / 程序偏差 / 無菌測試不合格）
           ↓
    開立偏差報告 (Deviation Report)
           ↓
    即時影響評估 (Immediate Impact Assessment)
    ├── 高影響：批次立即隔離
    └── 低影響：正常流程但標記待調查
           ↓
    根本原因調查 (Root Cause Analysis)
    ├── 批次擴展評估：哪些批次受影響？
    └── 書面論據：為何某批次排除在外？
           ↓
    CAPA 制定與批准
           ↓
    放行人員審查調查結論
    ├── 根本原因已識別且合理
    ├── 批次影響評估已完成
    └── CAPA 已批准（執行可pending）
           ↓
    ✓ 批次放行 或 ✗ 批次退回/隔離
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
blocks.en:
Handling of non-conformities before batch release:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Non-conformity identified (EM excursion / procedural deviation / sterility test failure)
           ↓
    Open Deviation Report
           ↓
    Immediate Impact Assessment
    ├── High impact: batch immediately quarantined
    └── Low impact: normal flow but flagged as under investigation
           ↓
    Root Cause Analysis
    ├── Batch extension assessment: which batches are affected?
    └── Documented rationale: why is a given batch excluded?
           ↓
    CAPA development and approval
           ↓
    Release personnel review the investigation conclusions
    ├── Root cause identified and justified
    ├── Batch impact assessment completed
    └── CAPA approved (implementation may be pending)
           ↓
    ✓ Batch released or ✗ Batch rejected/quarantined
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

blocks.zh: 在 Grade B 區域的主動空氣取樣發現了一個菌落（超過行動限值）。同時有三個批次在調查期間內進行了充填——Batch X、Y、Z。如果你是 QA 調查負責人，你的調查計畫應該包含哪些步驟？哪個批次最可能被建議排除在偏差範圍之外（例如因為充填時間在超標前後）？
blocks.en: Active air sampling in a Grade B area detects one colony (exceeding the action limit). Three batches were filled during the investigation period: Batch X, Y and Z. As the QA investigation lead, what steps should your investigation plan include? Which batch is most likely to be recommended for exclusion from the scope of the deviation (for example, because it was filled before or after the excursion)?

blocks.zh: 3.2 要求「排除批次的理由應清楚說明且記錄」。請設計一個簡單的調查報告模板章節，用於記錄批次排除論據。
blocks.en: Section 3.2 requires that "the rationale for excluding batches be clearly explained and documented". Design a simple section template for an investigation report to record the batch exclusion rationale.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 藥品品質系統（PQS）在無菌製造中必須超越 GMP Chapter 1 的基本要求，額外涵蓋七項特定義務，包括全生命週期風險管理、充分的技術知識、深入的根本原因分析、CCS 中的風險文件記錄等
blocks.en: In sterile manufacturing, the Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) must go beyond the basic requirements of GMP Chapter 1 and cover seven additional specific obligations, including lifecycle risk management, adequate technical knowledge, in-depth root cause analysis, and documentation of risk in the CCS

blocks.zh: 高階管理層（Senior Management）有明確的監督義務，必須定期、實質性地審查風險管理結果，不能流於形式
blocks.en: Senior Management has clear oversight obligations and must review risk management outcomes regularly and substantively, not as a formality

blocks.zh: 後端製程（包裝、儲存、運輸）也是 PQS 的管控範圍，容器密閉完整性（CCI）和冷鏈管控不可忽視
blocks.en: Downstream processes (packaging, storage, transport) also fall within the scope of PQS control; container closure integrity (CCI) and cold-chain control must not be overlooked

blocks.zh: 批次放行人員必須具備無菌製造的充分知識與經驗，放行決策是一個需要專業判斷的過程，而非純粹的行政流程
blocks.en: Batch release personnel must have adequate knowledge of and experience in sterile manufacturing; the release decision is a process requiring professional judgment, not a purely administrative step

blocks.zh: 所有非符合事項（EM 超標、無菌測試不合格、程序偏差）必須在批次放行前完成調查；批次是否納入調查範圍的論據必須有書面記錄
blocks.en: All non-conformities (EM excursions, sterility test failures, procedural deviations) must be investigated before batch release; the rationale for whether a batch is included in the scope of the investigation must be documented
